title: Vapouriz 50/50 BlackJack 10ml
description: Experience the classic flavour of blackjack sweets with this perfectly blended e-liquid rich in spicy notes of aniseed and punchy black liquorice, layered over a smooth and sweet base. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full Vapouriz 50/50 E-Liquid collection and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Vape Starter Kit or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options. What Is 50/50 E Liquid? 50/50 e-liquid is so called because it contains a 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio, which allows for an extremely versatile vaping experience. These liquids can be used in Starter Vape Kits, High powered Sub Ohm Kits and Pod Vape Kits. For more information, Check out the full 50/50 vape juice guide
